title_sq: Rruga Don Bosko, Tirane, Zyre per Shitje!
description_sq:
Buze rruges kryesore ne Don Bosko!
Zyra ndodhet ne pozicionin me te mire te nje prej objekteve me cilesore te zones se Don Boskos, me pamje te lire nga rruga kryesore dhe fasade xhami nga te gjitha anet.Ambienti eshte 500 m2 open space, lehtesisht i modifikueshem ne disa ambiente, me hyrje te vecanta. Numri i tualeteve mund te behet sipas kerkeses. 
Shkalla ka 2 ashensore, si dhe disponohen poste parkimi me cmim ekstra ne katin -1.
title_en: Don Bosco Street, Tirana, Sales Office!
description_en: On the side of the main road in Don Bosco! The office is located in the best position of one of the best buildings in the Don Bosco area, with a clear view from the main street and glass facades from all sides. The environment is 500 m2 open space, easily modifiable in some areas, with separate entrances. The number of toilets can be made according to the request. The staircase has 2 elevators, and parking spaces are available at an extra cost on the -1st floor.
